PUS DISCOUNT CODE SYSTEM
Discounts with coupons in the Power Up Store — support your Sponsor Streamer

📑 CONTENTS
01 · 🎟️ AT A GLANCE
02 · 🛒 HOW TO USE A DISCOUNT CODE?
03 · 🎁 COUPONS ON SINGLE ITEM PURCHASES
04 · 🛍️ COUPONS ON BASKET PURCHASES
05 · ⚠️ IMPORTANT — VIP AND FARM PACKS
06 · 🎥 SPONSOR STREAMER CODES
07 · 🔥 UP TO 30% OFF DURING EVENTS

09 · ✅ IN SHORT
10 · 🔗 LINKS

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎟️ 01 · AT A GLANCE


At SexyKO we've added a very special and different feature to the Power Up Store: with this system you can now use Sponsor Streamers' discount codes in your PUS purchases and complete your shopping at a better price.

This feature is a special structure built directly into the PUS system on the SexyKO and StoneSoft infrastructure. Players get a discount on their purchases and also support the Sponsor Streamer they back.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🛒 02 · HOW TO USE A DISCOUNT CODE?


Just type the discount code you want to use in the Coupon field at the bottom of the Power Up Store. Then click the CHECK button.

If the code is valid, the discount is activated automatically. So you can complete your purchase at the discounted price.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎁 03 · COUPONS ON SINGLE ITEM PURCHASES


Discount codes can be used not only for basket purchases but also on eligible single PUS items. If you have a valid coupon code when buying the item, the discount is applied directly to the purchase.

So you can use a Sponsor Streamer discount code even when buying a single item.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🛍️ 04 · COUPONS ON BASKET PURCHASES


You can also use the coupon system when you add several items to the Basket in PUS. The discount is applied to eligible items in the basket and your total is recalculated accordingly.

This way you can benefit from coupons on bulk PUS purchases too.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚠️ 05 · IMPORTANT — VIP AND FARM PACKS


◆ Can't be used on VIP Packs
◆ Can't be used on Farm Packs

That's because these packs are already made by combining several items and are sold at a better price than their normal total.

💡 Since these items already include a pack discount, a second coupon discount is not applied.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎥 06 · SPONSOR STREAMER CODES

One of the main purposes of the coupon system is to support SexyKO Sponsor Streamers. Special discount codes can be set up for Sponsor Streamers.

Players: use the Sponsor Streamer's code → get a discount on the PUS purchase → support the Sponsor Streamer.

So the player gets an advantage and the SexyKO streamer community is supported.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 07 · UP TO 30% OFF DURING EVENTS

During special event and campaign periods, Sponsor Streamer coupons can activate: 🎉 UP TO 30% DISCOUNTS. These special codes may not always be active.

So we recommend following:

◆ the Sponsor Streamers
◆ the SexyKO Discord channel
◆ the official announcements

💡 Don't miss the special campaign codes!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💎 08 · A SYSTEM UNIQUE TO SEXYKO & STONESOFT

At SexyKO we don't want to offer players just a classic Power Up Store. We're making the PUS system more useful, more rewarding and more connected to the community.

With the Sponsor Streamer Coupon System:

◆ You can use discounts on single PUS purchases
◆ You can use coupons on Basket purchases
◆ You can support Sponsor Streamers
◆ You can enjoy big discounts during events
◆ You can use your coupon directly on the in-game PUS screen

This system is one of the PUS features developed specifically for the SexyKO and StoneSoft infrastructure.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# PUS DISCOUNT CODE SYSTEM

*Discounts with coupons in the Power Up Store — support your Sponsor Streamer*

## 📑 Contents

01 · 🎟️ AT A GLANCE  
02 · 🛒 HOW TO USE A DISCOUNT CODE?  
03 · 🎁 COUPONS ON SINGLE ITEM PURCHASES  
04 · 🛍️ COUPONS ON BASKET PURCHASES  
05 · ⚠️ IMPORTANT — VIP AND FARM PACKS  
06 · 🎥 SPONSOR STREAMER CODES  
07 · 🔥 UP TO 30% OFF DURING EVENTS

09 · ✅ IN SHORT  
10 · 🔗 LINKS  

---

## 🎟️ 01 · AT A GLANCE

![]({{U00}})

At SexyKO we've added a very special and different feature to the Power Up Store: with this system you can now use Sponsor Streamers' discount codes in your PUS purchases and complete your shopping at a better price.

This feature is a special structure built directly into the PUS system on the SexyKO and StoneSoft infrastructure. **Players get a discount on their purchases and also support the Sponsor Streamer they back.**

---

## 🛒 02 · HOW TO USE A DISCOUNT CODE?

![]({{U01}})

Just type the discount code you want to use in the Coupon field at the bottom of the Power Up Store. Then click the **CHECK** button.

**If the code is valid, the discount is activated automatically.** So you can complete your purchase at the discounted price.

---

## 🎁 03 · COUPONS ON SINGLE ITEM PURCHASES

![]({{U02}})

Discount codes can be used not only for basket purchases but also on eligible single PUS items. If you have a valid coupon code when buying the item, the discount is applied directly to the purchase.

**So you can use a Sponsor Streamer discount code even when buying a single item.**

---

## 🛍️ 04 · COUPONS ON BASKET PURCHASES

![]({{U03}})

You can also use the coupon system when you add several items to the Basket in PUS. The discount is applied to eligible items in the basket and your total is recalculated accordingly.

**This way you can benefit from coupons on bulk PUS purchases too.**

---

## ⚠️ 05 · IMPORTANT — VIP AND FARM PACKS

![]({{U04}})

- **Can't be used on VIP Packs**
- **Can't be used on Farm Packs**

That's because these packs are already made by combining several items and are sold at a better price than their normal total.

💡 Since these items already include a pack discount, **a second coupon discount is not applied.**

---

## 🎥 06 · SPONSOR STREAMER CODES

One of the main purposes of the coupon system is to support SexyKO Sponsor Streamers. Special discount codes can be set up for Sponsor Streamers.

**Players:** use the Sponsor Streamer's code → get a discount on the PUS purchase → support the Sponsor Streamer.

So the player gets an advantage and the SexyKO streamer community is supported.

---

## 🔥 07 · UP TO 30% OFF DURING EVENTS

During special event and campaign periods, Sponsor Streamer coupons can activate: **🎉 UP TO 30% DISCOUNTS**. These special codes may not always be active.

So we recommend following:

- the Sponsor Streamers
- the SexyKO Discord channel
- the official announcements

💡 **Don't miss the special campaign codes!**

---

## 💎 08 · A SYSTEM UNIQUE TO SEXYKO & STONESOFT

At SexyKO we don't want to offer players just a classic Power Up Store. We're making the PUS system more useful, more rewarding and more connected to the community.

**With the Sponsor Streamer Coupon System:**

- You can use discounts on single PUS purchases
- You can use coupons on Basket purchases
- You can support Sponsor Streamers
- You can enjoy big discounts during events
- You can use your coupon directly on the in-game PUS screen

This system is one of the PUS features developed specifically for the SexyKO and StoneSoft infrastructure.

---
